summary: Completed frontend-only verification on preview URL for homepage announcement updates, custom cursor behavior, desktop/mobile layout, reduced-motion handling, and core navigation flows.

integration_issues.flow: Browser console/network logging during rapid navigation
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent net::ERR_ABORTED entries observed for /cdn-cgi/rum and some asset/module requests in failed/reload-heavy runs; core UI functionality still passed in final verification run.

action_items: Optional hardening: investigate repeated /cdn-cgi/rum net::ERR_ABORTED log noise in automation sessions.
Improve testability by adding data-testid to top-nav links and both REGISTER NOW CTAs (header + hero) for stable automated selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: Custom cursor implementation correctly gates activation by (pointer: fine) and prefers-reduced-motion; no critical logic issue found in reviewed files.
Testability gap: several key interactive navigation elements still rely on text/href matching instead of dedicated data-testid attributes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public preview URL only. Required announcement strings are present in uppercase at render due CSS uppercase styling but match requested content semantically. Desktop cursor behavior (crosshair + 6-dot trail + hover state) and reduced-motion disablement passed. Mobile viewport (390x844) remained readable with no horizontal overflow. True coarse-pointer hardware behavior was inferred from code + media-query conditions; automation environment primarily reports fine pointer.
rca of the issue: User-reported stale homepage content is resolved: source config values are updated in frontend/src/config/eventConfig.ts and rendered correctly in EventIntro. Prior script failures were due selector assumptions (href/text) rather than app regressions.
